decisions.rationale: No NOA or T4 is on file for this salaried applicant; only a pay stub and letter were provided.
Seasoned balance of about $50.8k with only small routine deposits covers the $41,000 down payment and closing costs.
Valeur Reference Inc. is on the panel, report of 2026/06/03 is recent, and value $430,000 supports the $410,000 price.
Recent signed letterhead letter confirms permanent full-time employment since 2016, consistent with stated income.
